_note: Ball-and-stick models. Bond length = sum of Cordero 2008 single-bond covalent radii; angles are textbook values. Ball radius = 25% of the Bondi 1964 van der Waals radius. Radii are in the element table below.

summary.en: The solvent of every cell. Two O–H bonds at about 104.5°. Bond length 0.97 Å, taken as the sum of the single-bond covalent radii; angles are textbook values.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞內所有反應嘅溶劑。兩條 O–H 鍵，夾角約 104.5°。 鍵長 0.97 Å，取單鍵共價半徑之和；角度為教科書數值。

text.en: Atomic number 8. 1 atom in this molecule. Covalent radius 0.66 Å, van der Waals radius 1.52 Å.
text.zh-Hant: 原子序 8。呢個分子有 1 個。共價半徑 0.66 Å，范德華半徑 1.52 Å。

summary.en: Nitrogen waste from amino acid breakdown. Three N–H bonds in a pyramid, H–N–H about 107°. Bond length 1.02 Å, taken as the sum of the single-bond covalent radii; angles are textbook values.
summary.zh-Hant: 氨基酸分解產生嘅含氮廢物。三條 N–H 鍵成錐形，H–N–H 約 107°。 鍵長 1.02 Å，取單鍵共價半徑之和；角度為教科書數值。

summary.en: The simplest organic molecule. Four C–H bonds point to the corners of a tetrahedron, 109.5° apart. Bond length 1.07 Å, taken as the sum of the single-bond covalent radii; angles are textbook values.
